intelligence.description: Frontier AI lab building products for autonomous and long-horizon research workflows.
company: Quadrillion builds systems intended to automate parts of computational research. Its Qualia product plans and runs experiments, interprets results and proposes new directions, with local, cloud and on-premises deployment options.

The company says its Lemma model is trained to make complex research decisions over long horizons, including developing hypotheses, allocating compute and interpreting results. It has not publicly disclosed financing, operating metrics or a valuation.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Research automation could matter across scientific and industrial R&D if systems can reliably improve the quality and speed of experimentation. The relevant proof is measured research output and scientist adoption, not merely agent demonstrations.
